name: nova-studio
description: Plateforme SaaS interne de generation de contenus IA (KIE.ai)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nova/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nova/api && npm run typecheck -w @nova/web
